exposure: hemizygous variant of the ATP11C gene (c.3136a>t/p ile 1046phe)
frame-shift variant of the ANK1 gene (c.937del/pala313 leufs*19)
outcome: low total red blood cells count
low proliferation of red blood cell system in bone marrow
normalization of serum ferritin and vitamin B12 levels post-treatment
improved hemoglobin and reticulocyte values post-treatment
cohort: A single male infant of Han descent, born at 40+4 weeks gestation via cesarean section.
finding: This case report identified novel hemizygous variants of the ATP11C gene and a frame-shift variant of the ANK1 gene in an infant presenting with unexplained congenital hemolytic anemia and described his clinical course and response to treatment.
